title: Protocol for Culturing and Extracting DNA from Fungal Isolates
author: Temitope R. Folorunso
materials: All reagents were commercially purchased, mixed and modified according to existing protocol Preparation of 1 L of solid 3 % Malt extract agar (MEA) medium
Weigh 15 g of DifcoTM Bacto Agar.
Allow medium to circulate the bottom of plate.
Allow media to circulate the bottom of plate.
Preparation of 1 L Sabouraud dextrose (SD) broth
Needle surface sterilization and fungal culturing
Give it a radial pattern arrangement.
Make triplicate of samples per colony.
Inoculation of pure fungal on liquid broth
All reagents were commercially purchased, mixed and modified according to existing protocol. Pre-washing of Mycelia
Weigh and measure all reagents according to desired final volume.

steps.title: Prepare Sabouraud Dextrose Agar (SDA) Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of solid SDA medium.

substeps.instruction: Measure 1000 mL of distilled water and weigh 5 g of peptone.
Mix reagents in a 1000 mL PYREX Erlenmeyer flask.
Add a magnetic stirrer and heat on a Fisher Thermix stirring hotplate at 60 °C.
Allow the mixture to clear and become free of particles.

steps.title: Prepare Petri Dishes
steps.instruction: Sterilize the workspace and pour media into petri dishes.

substeps.instruction: Clean the flow hood with conflicts followed by 70% ethanol.
Expose the flow hood to UV light for 10 minutes.
Use sterilized 100 x 15 mm (VWR) petri dishes.
Pour approximately 30 mL of media into each petri dish under the laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Verify Media Sterility
steps.instruction: Incubate the prepared plates for ~48 hours at 22 °C to confirm no contamination.

steps.title: Sterilize Fungal Samples
steps.instruction: Process symptomatic needles within three days of field collection.

substeps.instruction: Remove 4-5 needle strands from samples and cut into 3-4 cm pieces.
Place needles in a beaker and guide them using white cheesecloth.
Dip the cloth containing needles in 7.5% sodium hypochlorite for 30 seconds.
Rinse with distilled water for 30 seconds.
Wash with 70% ethanol for 30 seconds.
Rinse again with distilled water for 30 seconds.
Set the cloth with needles aside to dry.

steps.title: Isolate Fungal Colonies
steps.instruction: Culture the sterilized needles on SDA media.

substeps.instruction: In an aseptic environment, place cleaned needles on the media plates.
Prepare each sample in four replicates.
Seal plates with parafilm.
Arrange plates in a tray and incubate at 37 °C.
Check plates weekly for sporulation and growth.

steps.title: Purify Fungal Culture
steps.instruction: Isolate and grow pure fungal colonies.

substeps.instruction: Identify distinct colonies grown around the needles.
Scrape the edge of each colony into a small 60 mm media plate and seal with parafilm.
Using forceps, scrape the tip of the pure fungal colony.
Inoculate the pure fungal culture into liquid broth in 125 mL PYREX Erlenmeyer flasks.
Seal with a cotton plug and aluminum foil.
Label samples and incubate at 37 °C.

steps.title: Harvest and Wash Mycelia
steps.instruction: Collect and clean mycelia from the liquid broth.

substeps.instruction: Harvest mycelia after one to two weeks of incubation.
Transfer mycelia to sterilized 50 mL falcon tubes.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes using a Thermoscientific Multifuge X Pro series.
Remove the supernatant media.
Add 1 mL of 1X phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.5) and mix vigorously by vortexing.
Centrifuge at 5000 x g for 5 minutes.
Repeat the wash until clean mycelial pellets are obtained.

steps.title: Prepare Sorbitol Wash Buffer (SWB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of sorbitol wash buffer.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following in a 1000 mL PYREX Erlenmeyer flask: 100 mL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 63.76 g Sorbitol powder, 10 mL of 0.5 M EDTA, and 10 g PVP-40 powder.
Add a magnetic stirrer and heat on a Fisher Thermix stirring hotplate at 60 °C.
Allow the mixture to dissolve thoroughly without particles.

steps.title: Mechanical Cell Disruption
steps.instruction: Disrupt fungal cells using a Precellys system.

substeps.instruction: Immediately before use, mix 10 µL of β-Mercaptoethanol (β-ME, Lot no 23F2056260) per 1 mL of sorbitol buffer (1% v/v) to create SWB-βME.
Weigh 200 mg – 300 mg of fungal mycelia and transfer to a 2 mL screw-cap tube.
Add 1 mL of SWB-βME solution and one beating bead to each sample.
Disrupt cells using a Precellys at 9100 RPM for three cycles of 30 seconds each, with 5-second pauses between cycles.
Centrifuge homogenized mixtures at 17000 x g for 5 minutes.
Repeat if necessary until the pellet settles.
Combine the following in a 1000 mL Erlenmeyer flask: 100 mL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 30 g CTAB powder, 81.9 g NaCl (or 280 mL of 5 M NaCl), 40 mL of 0.5 M EDTA, and 10 g PVP-40 powder.
Add a magnetic stirrer and heat on a Fisher Thermix stirring hotplate at 60 °C and mix.

steps.title: Chemical Lysis and Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the mycelia using CTAB and Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 3% CTAB buffer, 15 µL of β-ME, and 15 µL of proteinase K (20 μg/μl) to the sorbitol-washed mycelia.
Disrupt cells again using a Precellys at 9100 RPM for three cycles of 30 seconds each, with 5-second pauses between cycles.
Incubate the mixture for 3 hours on a VWR incubating microplate shaker at 65 °C.
Centrifuge at 17000 x g at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using phenol-chloroform extractions and RNase treatment.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a new 2 µL tube.
Add an equal volume of phenol-chloroform-isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, and centrifuge at 17000 x g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the upper phase to a fresh 2 µL tube.
Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), incubate for 5 minutes, and centrifuge at 17000 x g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the resulting supernatant to a new tube.
Add 5 µL of 100 μg/μl RNase A and incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation and Recovery
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the DNA for final recovery.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.2 volumes of 10 M ammonium acetate (NH4Ac) and 0.8 volumes of ice-cold 100% isopropanol to the mixture.
Incubate at -20 °C overnight to precipitate the DNA.
Remove residual liquid using a pipette.
Centrifuge at 17000 x g for 10 minutes to pellet the DNA.
Wash the pellets twice with 70% ethanol.
Resuspend the final DNA in 50 µL - 100 µL of nuclease-free water.
